# The Bad Blood Clan
The Bad Bloods are Yautja cast out of their clans. They follow no honour code and hunt everyone. They are a [bold]Distress Signal threat[/bold]: a small clan lands, builds a camp called the [bold]Lodge[/bold], plants [bold]Clan Totems[/bold] around the map, and grows stronger with every body it takes home.
The first half of this page is for [color=#a4885c]marines[/color]. The second half is for [color=#a4885c]Bad Bloods[/color].
## How each side wins [color=#a4885c]Marines win[/color] (Marine Major) in any of these ways: - [bold]Vessel Strike:[/bold] work through the objective chain and destroy the clan ship in orbit. - [bold]Leader and Lodge:[/bold] the Lodge is destroyed and the clan has no Leader. - [bold]Wipe:[/bold] no Bad Blood is left alive.
[color=#a4885c]Bad Bloods win[/color] in either of these ways: - [bold]The clan ship:[/bold] the Lodge is still standing when the clan ship leaves orbit. - Wipe out the marines.
[bold]The clock that matters is the clan ship.[/bold] The clan can only call it by holding [bold]3 ripe Totems for 10 minutes[/bold] in a row, and never earlier than 45 minutes after it lands. The ship then takes 20 minutes to arrive and stays 20 minutes. [bold]Keep the clan below 3 ripe Totems and the ship never comes.[/bold]
# For marines
## Your checklist The GOVFOR objectives console tracks these. Do them in parallel, not one at a time. - [bold]Restore the colony:[/bold] any 2 of reactor power, a comms tower and the sensor tower. - [bold]Deny the Totems:[/bold] desecrate them, then destroy them. - [bold]Find the Lodge:[/bold] see "Finding the Lodge" below. - [bold]Steal the clan signature:[/bold] from a Totem, the Lodge, the star chart or a bracer. - [bold]Run the uplink[/bold] at a working tower or a field uplink relay. - [bold]Fire the Vessel Strike[/bold] and keep its lock site working for 18 minutes. - [bold]Recover your dead[/bold] within 5 minutes.
Every marine step [bold]stays done[/bold] once finished. Every marine timer [bold]pauses instead of resetting[/bold] when the clan interferes.
## Step 1: Restore the colony Any [bold]2 of these 3[/bold]. ARES announces each one. - [bold]Reactor power:[/bold] keep a colony reactor Working for [bold]5 minutes[/bold]. The 5 minutes pause while it is down. - [bold]Comms tower:[/bold] switch a planet comms tower On. - [bold]Sensor tower:[/bold] a marine switches the sensor tower On.
A working comms tower also gives you an [bold]early warning[/bold] when the clan starts its ship call, with the time left.
## Step 2: Steal the clan signature You need it [bold]once[/bold]. Any one of these: - [bold]Survey a Totem:[/bold] right-click a [bold]desecrated[/bold] Totem, choose [bold]Survey Totem[/bold], and hold still for [bold]75 seconds[/bold]. Moving or taking damage interrupts you. - [bold]Survey the Lodge:[/bold] right-click the Lodge, choose [bold]Survey Lodge[/bold], and hold still for [bold]75 seconds[/bold]. The Lodge must be [bold]revealed on the tactical map[/bold] when you finish. Have someone keep hitting it: every hit keeps it revealed for 30 more seconds. - [bold]Clan star chart:[/bold] when the clan calls its ship, a star chart appears at the Lodge armory. The first marine to pick it up gets the signature. - [bold]Looted bracer:[/bold] take a Bad Blood bracer to a working uplink site (a comms or sensor tower that is On, or a field relay). Click the site with the bracer to seat it, then use [bold]wirecutters[/bold] on the site (5 s), then a [bold]wrench[/bold] (5 s). The bracer is used up. A seated bracer can no longer self-destruct.
## Step 3: Run the uplink Needs Step 1 [bold]and[/bold] Step 2. Right-click a working uplink site and choose [bold]Run uplink[/bold]. Hold still with a free hand. - [bold]Comms tower or sensor tower[/bold] that is On: [bold]90 seconds[/bold]. - [bold]Field uplink relay:[/bold] [bold]150 seconds[/bold].
The site you use becomes the [bold]lock site[/bold] for the Vessel Strike. Pick one you can hold.
[bold]Field uplink relay:[/bold] Requisitions sells it on Bad Blood rounds (Research, 1500 points). Use the kit in hand to plant it ([bold]20 seconds[/bold], needs [bold]open sky[/bold]). Its battery lasts [bold]60 minutes[/bold] once planted. Bad Bloods can shoot it down or sabotage it, which destroys it.
## Step 4: Fire the Vessel Strike - The [bold]Commanding Officer, Executive Officer or a Staff Officer[/bold] selects [bold]Vessel Strike[/bold] at a GOVFOR overwatch console. It needs a [bold]ready orbital battery[/bold] on the ship. - The strike takes [bold]18 minutes[/bold]. Both sides are told. It works whether or not the clan ship has been called. - It [bold]pauses while the lock site is not working[/bold]. Sabotaging the lock site also adds [bold]60 seconds[/bold] (once per pause). - [bold]To resume:[/bold] repair the lock site, or right-click another working uplink site and choose [bold]Re-route lock[/bold] ([bold]30 seconds[/bold]). Re-routing only works while the lock site is down. - A repaired or re-routed site [bold]cannot be sabotaged or damaged for 3 minutes[/bold]. - [bold]Guard the console.[/bold] From 40 minutes into the round the clan Leader can hijack a dropship to the ship. A Bad Blood at the firing console cancels the strike in 30 seconds and locks it out for 5 minutes. You keep the uplink; fire again with another ready battery. - When the timer runs out the clan vessel is destroyed: [color=#a4885c]Marine Major[/color].
## Clan Totems A Totem pays the clan Superiority Points every minute it is [bold]consecrated[/bold] (the normal state), no matter who stands near it. It ripens with age: ripe after [bold]20 minutes[/bold]. Three ripe Totems start the ship call. - [bold]Spotting them:[/bold] marines are told the area when one is raised. It shows on your tactical map [bold]2 minutes[/bold] later. Totems stand at least 20 tiles from the Lodge and from each other. - [bold]Desecrate:[/bold] right-click it, choose [bold]Desecrate Totem[/bold], hold still for [bold]45 seconds[/bold]. Moving or taking damage interrupts you, so post guards. - A desecrated Totem [bold]pays nothing, is not ripe[/bold], gives the clan no aura, and they cannot build walls from it. - [bold]It is not permanent.[/bold] A Bad Blood can [bold]Reconsecrate[/bold] it in 45 seconds, and a Totem keeps aging while desecrated, so an old one is ripe again the moment it is reconsecrated. - [bold]Destroy it[/bold] for good. It has 600 health. Rifles do little (a fireteam takes about 10 seconds); explosives do full damage. Destroying one is a GOVFOR objective, gives intel, and [bold]reveals the Lodge for 90 seconds[/bold]. - [bold]Read it first.[/bold] A desecrated Totem can be read for intel and surveyed for the signature (below) before you knock it down.
## Finding the Lodge The Lodge is hidden from your tactical map until something reveals it: - [bold]Hitting the Lodge:[/bold] 30 seconds, renewed by every hit. - [bold]The clan buys a reinforcement squad:[/bold] 60 seconds. - [bold]Decrypting a Bad Blood bracer:[/bold] 60 seconds. - [bold]Destroying a Totem:[/bold] 90 seconds. - [bold]The clan ship is called:[/bold] the Lodge stays on the map until the round ends or the ship turns back. - [bold]No Bad Blood is alive:[/bold] it stays on the map. - [bold]Reading a Totem[/bold] gives you its 10-by-10 grid square (rangefinder coordinates), without revealing it.
## Intel sources - [bold]Read the totem[/bold] (right-click a desecrated Totem, [bold]25 seconds[/bold], once per desecration). Refused while a living Bad Blood is within 7 tiles. Gives: the Lodge's grid square, how many ripe Totems the clan holds, and how long until its ship is called. - [bold]Decrypt data-core[/bold] (right-click a Bad Blood bracer nobody alive is wearing, [bold]30 seconds[/bold], needs intel training). Gives: the Lodge on the map for 60 seconds and the clan ship's status. The bracer then counts as intel for the intel area. - [bold]Strip a trophy[/bold] (right-click the Lodge, [bold]10 seconds[/bold] each). Each trophy is intel for the intel area. - [bold]Clan star chart[/bold] (at the Lodge armory once the ship is called). Gives: the clan ship's timing and the clan signature. It is also intel.
## Killing the clan - [bold]The Lodge[/bold] has 900 health. Rifle fire barely scratches it. [bold]Explosives deal double damage[/bold] and fire burns it. It slowly heals if nobody hits it for a minute. When it falls, every clan wall crumbles. - [bold]The Leader:[/bold] while a Lodge stands, a dead Leader is replaced by a clan vote within 2 minutes. With no Lodge, a dead Leader means you win. - After the Lodge falls, the Leader can pitch a new one 5 minutes later. [bold]Kill the Leader inside that window.[/bold] - [bold]Destroying the Lodge turns back an inbound clan ship.[/bold] Once the ship has arrived, destroying the Lodge pauses its departure. - If every Bad Blood dies, the clan gets one last squad at its Lodge if it can pay for one. If nobody is left 2 minutes later, you win. A clan whose ship has arrived cannot be wiped out this way: take the Lodge. - A Bad Blood who ghosts is replaced by another player.
## Fighting tips - [bold]Recover your dead within 5 minutes.[/bold] The clan cannot skin a body, take its head, skull or ribcage, or roast it whole until it has rotted past its revival window (5 minutes after death, longer in stasis). A body you get back denies them up to 5 SP and stone for their walls. - [bold]Chase the dragger.[/bold] A Bad Blood dragging or carrying a body moves at about a third of its speed. - [bold]Guard your vehicles.[/bold] Bad Bloods deal triple damage to vehicles in melee, their lethal bolts hit vehicles, and they can [bold]Force hatch[/bold] a locked vehicle in 15 seconds with their bare hands and climb in. - [bold]Melee works.[/bold] Bad Bloods take extra damage from blades and clubs. Armor-piercing rounds, shotguns, explosives and fire all work. Fire also stops them cloaking. - Their caster bolts fly at most [bold]16 tiles[/bold]. Keep your distance. - Every Bad Blood has a long-range clan communicator. Breaking the comms towers does not cut them off. - Newly landed grunts are lightly armored. A clan that has had time to shop at its armory is not.
# For Bad Bloods
## Joining the clan - The clan needs [bold]30 players[/bold] to appear on the threat vote. - It lands as [bold]1 Leader and 4 grunts[/bold], plus one more grunt for about every 12 players above 30, and one sleeping hound for every two Bad Bloods, rounded up. - Players who asked for the threat are seated first. Voters without a body wait in the [bold]Blood Reserve[/bold] and are first in line for new seats. You can leave the reserve for the lobby. - Pitching the first Lodge opens a free [bold]founding squad[/bold] for the reserve. - Bad Bloods, hounds and open seats together never exceed [bold]35% of the players on the server[/bold]. - If you ghost, your Bad Blood or hound is offered to another player. - There is no honourable hunt on a Bad Blood round.
## Your kit Every Bad Blood lands with: - a scavenged bracer with a plasma caster and a melee weapon of your choice; - a [bold]Modified Communicator[/bold]: a long-range clan channel that works with the comms towers down; - a filled medicomp and a health shard; - a ceremonial dagger, a polishing rag and a cleanser gel vial, for trophies; - two hunting traps, a water flask, a hunting pouch, a toolbelt and a hound observation pad.
[bold]Grunts[/bold] wear patchwork armor (20 melee / 25 bullet / 20 bio / 30 explosion).
[bold]The Leader[/bold] wears Leader-grade armor (30 / 55 / 30 / 40) and carries an extra healing capsule, and sees as an honourable hunter does, like an Engineer. Tier II and III wares open to the Leader one tier early. Only the Leader can pitch the Lodge, call squads while alive, buy the lethal bolt and the eradicator, fire the eradicator, and hijack a dropship.
[bold]Your hide:[/bold] before armor you take 40% of blunt, 45% of slash, 30% of piercing and 50% of burn damage, half of poison and all of caustic. You are softer in melee and tougher against fire than an honourable hunter.
## The Lodge - The Leader uses [bold]Pitch Camp[/bold] to get a Lodge kit, then uses it on open ground away from the landing zones. - One Lodge at a time. If it falls, the Leader can pitch a new one after 5 minutes. - It has 900 health and heals slowly when left alone. Explosives and fire are what threaten it. - It shows on the marines' map when it is hit, when you buy a squad, when a marine decrypts one of your bracers, when a Totem is destroyed, and for as long as your ship is called or in orbit.
The Lodge comes with eight parts: - [bold]Spit:[/bold] cook bodies and meat for food and SP, refill your flask. - [bold]Ascension Stone:[/bold] call reinforcement squads, choose a new Leader. - [bold]Armory:[/bold] spend your own Honour on equipment. - [bold]Kennel:[/bold] buy hounds. - [bold]Cauldron:[/bold] boil prepared limbs down to bone. - [bold]Quarry:[/bold] draw bricks for walls, barricades and doors. - [bold]Forge-bench:[/bold] take up the Engineer path, and the Engineers' store. - [bold]Medicine cache:[/bold] take up the Medic path, and the Medics' store.
## Castes A Bad Blood may take up a caste at its station on the Lodge, for the rest of that life. The clan may have one of each caste for every four Bad Bloods, and always at least one. - [bold]Engineer:[/bold] sees as an honourable hunter does, builds walls and barricades anywhere, and plants charges. The forge-bench sells demolition charges and a siege plasma rifle that tears into vehicles. - [bold]Medic:[/bold] works Yautja medicine faster than other Bad Bloods. The medicine cache sells gels, clamps, injectors and the medicomp cheaper than the armory.
## Knowing your clan Every Bad Blood carries a clan code. Other Bad Bloods see you, and the radio names you, by your role and code: [bold]Leader (BB-12)[/bold], [bold]Engineer (BB-31)[/bold], [bold]Grunt (BB-45)[/bold].
## Superiority Points (SP) The clan earns two kinds of points, so gear never eats the points meant for reinforcements: - [bold]Clan SP[/bold] is shared and buys squads, hounds and Totems. It comes from cooking bodies and from Totems. Hauling bodies home and cooking them is how you feed the clan. - [bold]Honour[/bold] is yours alone and buys armory gear. It comes from the trophies you offer at the Lodge. Both count towards the clan's armory tiers. One body is worth up to [bold]4 Honour[/bold] to whoever offers its trophies and [bold]3 clan SP[/bold] from cooking.
[bold]A body must rot first.[/bold] You can take arms, legs and other limbs from a fresh kill. You can only [bold]skin[/bold] a body (butcher Skin, or flay with the ceremonial dagger), take its [bold]head[/bold], take [bold]skull or ribcage[/bold] trophies, or [bold]roast it whole[/bold] once it is past its revival window (5 minutes after death, longer in stasis). Until then the marines can still save it.
[bold]Trophies: 2 Honour each to the one who offers them, at most 2 trophies from one body.[/bold] - Polish hard trophies (skulls, spines, torsos, bones) with the [bold]polishing rag[/bold]. - Cure soft trophies (hides, scalps, pelts) with the [bold]cleanser gel[/bold], one piece at a time. - Use the prepared trophy on the Lodge and wait 3 seconds. A trophy can only be offered once.
[bold]Cooking: up to 3 SP from one body.[/bold] - A whole rotten corpse on the spit: 3 SP. - Loose cuts of prey meat: 0.5 SP each, out of the same 3 SP.
[bold]Prey[/bold] is any human or xeno, of any faction, that was dead when you took from it. Yautja, synthetics, larvae and parasites pay nothing.
[bold]Dragging is slow.[/bold] You drag or carry a body at 45% speed. Clear the way before you haul.
## Clan Totems - Any Bad Blood can use [bold]Raise Clan Totem[/bold]. The first is free, each one after costs 3 SP. - It needs open sky and at least 20 tiles from the Lodge and other Totems, and 25 from a landing zone. - The clan holds up to 3 Totems (4 on rounds with more than 80 players). - A consecrated Totem pays SP every minute, whoever is nearby: - young (first 10 minutes): 0.2 SP a minute; - growing (10 to 20 minutes): 0.4 SP a minute; - ripe (after 20 minutes): 0.7 SP a minute. - Totem SP counts only half towards armory tiers. - [bold]Aura:[/bold] Bad Bloods within 7 tiles of a consecrated Totem get hungry more slowly and heal slowly while out of combat. - Examine a Totem to see its stage, its rate and what it has paid. - Marines are told when you raise one, and it shows on their map after 2 minutes.
[bold]Desecration.[/bold] A marine can right-click a Totem and hold still for 45 seconds to desecrate it. A desecrated Totem pays nothing, gives no aura, is not ripe, and walls cannot be built from it. - To take it back, right-click it and choose [bold]Reconsecrate Totem[/bold], then hold still for [bold]45 seconds[/bold]. Moving or taking damage interrupts you. - Interrupt a marine's desecration by hitting them. - A desecrated Totem lets marines read the Lodge's location and steal the clan signature from it. Stay close: they cannot read it while you are within 7 tiles.
## Fortifications
- The quarry starts with [bold]40 stone[/bold] and holds up to [bold]100[/bold]. - It refills [bold]+10[/bold] per trophy offered, [bold]+2[/bold] per whole SP a Totem pays, and [bold]+6[/bold] per sabotage. - Draw bricks 10 at a time. Hand back what you do not use. - [bold]Clan stone wall:[/bold] 4 bricks, 1000 health. Explosives break it. - [bold]Clan stone barricade:[/bold] 2 bricks. - [bold]Clan stone door:[/bold] 6 bricks. It opens only for a Bad Blood bracer. - You can only build [bold]within 12 tiles of the Lodge or a consecrated Totem[/bold]. - When a Totem falls, walls near it crumble unless the Lodge or another Totem is also in range. When the Lodge falls, [bold]every[/bold] wall crumbles.
## The armory Everything here costs your own [bold]Honour[/bold]. Tiers open with the clan's [bold]lifetime SP and Honour[/bold]: [bold]tier II at 12[/bold], [bold]tier III at 30[/bold]. Tier IV opens when the clan ship arrives.
Your weapon grows with you: the bracer weapon you pick on landing is the [bold]starter[/bold]; at tier II the forge makes it [bold]forged[/bold] (a fifth more damage); at tier III the [bold]blessed[/bold] weapons, gold-sprited and about a quarter stronger, are on sale.
[bold]Tier I[/bold] - Cleanser gel vial: 2 - Hunting traps (two), healing capsule, stabiliser gel: 3 each - Harpoon, ceremonial dagger: 4 each - Smart disc: 5
[bold]Tier II[/bold] - Wrist blade, scimitar and chain gauntlet attachments, bracer shield attachment, hunter spear, armored clan mask: 4 each - Combistick, clan sword, chainwhip, war axe: 6 each - Forge your bracer weapon (+20% damage): 5 - Full clan armor (25 / 50 / 25 / 35): 7 - Lethal bolt unlock for the whole clan: 7, Leader only, once
[bold]Tier III[/bold] - War glaive, dual war scythe: 8 each - Leader-grade armor (30 / 55 / 30 / 40): 9 - Blessed hunter spear and the three blessed ancient shields: 9 each - Blessed chainwhip, dual war scythe, war axe: 10 each - Blessed severing sword, cruel staff, war glaive: 11 each - Scavenged spike launcher: 10, one per hunter - Hivebreaker: 11, one per hunter - Eradicator unlock: 11, Leader only, once
## The plasma caster - [bold]Stun[/bold] and [bold]immobilizer[/bold]: from the landing. - [bold]Lethal bolt:[/bold] after the Leader buys it, for the whole clan. One bolt every [bold]10 seconds[/bold]. It hits and damages vehicles. - [bold]Eradicator:[/bold] Leader only, after the lethal bolt. One shot, then a 10-minute cooldown. - Bracer power per shot: stun 60, immobilizer 300, lethal 150, eradicator 1500. - Every Bad Blood bolt flies at most [bold]16 tiles[/bold].
## Reinforcements and hounds - The Leader calls [bold]squads[/bold] at the Ascension Stone (any Bad Blood can while there is no Leader): 1 grunt for 7 SP, 3 grunts for 16 SP, 5 grunts for 24 SP. - Seats go out as ghost roles, Blood Reserve first. Unclaimed seats are refunded. - [bold]Buying a squad reveals the Lodge to the marines for 60 seconds.[/bold] - [bold]Hounds[/bold] cost 6 SP at the kennel. A hound arrives asleep and is reserved for its buyer for one minute; waking it offers it as a ghost role. - Your traps and smart discs ignore your own hounds.
## Staying alive - You get [bold]hungry and thirsty[/bold]. Eat only prey cooked at the Lodge spit and drink only water from your flask. - Starving slows you, slows bracer power and limb regrowth, hurts you, and stops your cloak. - The medicomp treats wounds in three steps (stabilise, tend, clamp), about 20 seconds in all. - A dead Bad Blood stays dead.
## Fighting as a Bad Blood - [bold]Cloak:[/bold] 25 seconds, then a 30-second cooldown. It is faint when you stand still and clearly visible when you move. - [bold]Ambush:[/bold] your first hit from cloak deals 30% more damage and drops the cloak for 4 seconds. A cloak stripped by a bullet, EMP or fire stays down for 10 seconds. - [bold]Breaching:[/bold] wrist blades, the scimitar and the chain gauntlet deal bonus damage to barricades and other structures. - [bold]Wide swing:[/bold] right click swings any Yautja melee weapon wide. The chain gauntlet shoves instead. - [bold]Vehicles:[/bold] you deal triple damage to vehicles in melee. Right-click a locked vehicle and choose [bold]Force hatch[/bold] (15 seconds, no tool) to break its lock and climb in. - [bold]Mask vision:[/bold] shows people and creatures through walls, but not rooms, items or structures. - You cannot fire human guns, raise thralls or link thralls. A Hivebreaker turns one downed xeno into a thrall. - Bad Bloods are [bold]dishonoured[/bold]: no rank, no honour, worth no honour to anyone.
## When the Leader dies - With a Lodge standing, an [bold]ascension vote[/bold] opens and every Bad Blood is asked over their bracer whether to claim the Lodge (the Ascension Stone works too, and shows the vote again if you closed it). Any living Bad Blood can stand, and every Bad Blood votes. - The vote lasts 60 seconds, plus 10 per candidate, up to 2 minutes. Ties go to the candidate with more kills, then to whoever stood first. - Every other leader bracer [bold]scuttles[/bold]: a 10-second warning, then a small blast. It cannot be taken off or picked up meanwhile. - [bold]If the Leader dies with no Lodge standing, the marines win.[/bold]
## The clan ship - [bold]The call:[/bold] hold [bold]3 ripe, consecrated Totems for 10 minutes[/bold] without a break, with the Lodge standing. Never earlier than 45 minutes after the landing. - Losing or desecrating a ripe Totem restarts the 10 minutes. Marines with a working comms tower hear the hold start. - When the ship is called, a [bold]clan star chart[/bold] appears at the Lodge armory. Do not let the marines take it. - [bold]Inbound:[/bold] 20 minutes. The Lodge is on the marines' map the whole time. [bold]If the Lodge falls, the ship turns back.[/bold] - [bold]Arrived:[/bold] one free grunt seat every minute while the clan has a Leader and a Lodge; armory tier IV (war glaive and Leader-grade armor at half price, every bracer can fire the eradicator, free lethal bolt); a free smart disc for every living Bad Blood. - [bold]Departure:[/bold] if the Lodge stands for 20 minutes after the arrival, the clan leaves with its trophies and wins. The timer stops while no Lodge stands.
## Stopping the Vessel Strike - Right-click a sensor tower, comms tower, field relay or colony reactor and choose [bold]Sabotage[/bold] ([bold]25 seconds[/bold]). Towers and reactors break and need repairs; a field relay is destroyed. Switching a tower off by hand does not work. - Sabotaging the strike's lock site pauses the strike and adds 60 seconds. Sabotaging a reactor pauses the marines' reactor hold. Each sabotage adds 6 stone to the quarry. - A site the marines just repaired or re-routed to is immune for 3 minutes. Hit the others meanwhile. - From [bold]40 minutes[/bold] into the round the Leader can [bold]hijack a dropship[/bold] to the marine ship. A living Bad Blood at the console the strike was fired from can sabotage it in [bold]30 seconds[/bold]. The marines get an ARES warning. This cancels the strike and locks it out for 5 minutes.
